tabs.label: What to edit
tabs.later: Statuses, tags and validation come in a later release.

shared.title: {record} shares its fields with {other}
shared.body: A customer and a supplier are one party: a field added here shows on both.

readOnly.title: You can read the fields and lists
readOnly.body: Adding, changing or archiving them needs the right to manage fields.

refused.title: Fields & lists is not in your role
refused.body: Ask an administrator for the right to see fields and lists.

error.title: The fields could not be read
error.forbiddenTitle: Fields & lists is not in your role

fields.title: Custom fields
fields.emptyBody: Add the first one: pick its type, name it in Italian and English, and say who sees it.
fields.emptyBodyView: Nobody has added a field to this record type yet.
fields.allArchived: Every field of this record type is archived.

typeHint.NUMBER: A number, with a unit if you like (mm, kg).
typeHint.MONEY: An amount and its currency, seen only with its money right.
typeHint.LINK: Another record: an order, a style, a lot…

audience.PERSONAL: People who may read personal data

audienceHint.INTERNAL: Everyone who may read the record sees it.
audienceHint.MONEY: Only people holding its money right see it; for everyone else it is left out.
audienceHint.PERSONAL: Only people with the personal-data right see it.

preview.title: Form preview
preview.hint: How the {record} form looks with these fields.
preview.emptyBody: The preview fills as fields are added.
preview.note: A preview: try the controls, nothing is saved.
preview.file: Pick one of the record's files

fieldDialog.title: Add field to {record}
fieldDialog.fixed: A field keeps its type, key, list and link: add a new field to change them.
fieldDialog.codeHint: Lower-case letters, digits and underscores (heat_number). It never changes.
fieldDialog.requiredHint: Whoever changes the record must fill it.
fieldDialog.moneyAudience: A money field is seen only by people holding its money right: pick which one.
fieldDialog.grainHint: Only people with this right see the field.
fieldDialog.whereAlways: On the record's form, and in its lists, filters and exports, for the people who see it.
fieldDialog.portalHint: Partners read it on their own records in the portal.
fieldDialog.previewEmpty: Pick a type to see the field.

whose.everyHint: The records of every company show it.
whose.oneHint: Only this company's records, and shared master data, show it.
whose.listOneHint: Only this company's fields may pick from it.

lists.title: Picklists
lists.usedElsewhere_one: No {record} field picks from it; {count} field of another record type does.
lists.usedElsewhere_other: No {record} field picks from it; {count} fields of other record types do.
lists.unused: No field picks from it yet.
lists.shared: Every record type may use a list.
lists.emptyBody: Make the first list, then add its values with a colour and an icon.
lists.emptyBodyView: Nobody has made a list yet.
lists.archivedBody: No new field can pick from it until it is restored; records keep their values.

values.emptyBody: Add the first value: its code, its labels, a colour and an icon.
values.emptyBodyView: This list has no values yet.

listDialog.title: New list
listDialog.intro: A list holds the values a select field offers; every record type may use it.
listDialog.codeHint: Lower-case letters, digits and underscores (leather_grade). It never changes.

valueDialog.title: New value in {list}
valueDialog.codeHint: Upper-case letters, digits and underscores (FULL_GRAIN). It never changes.
valueDialog.descriptionHint: Optional: what the value means, up to 500 characters.

look.title: Icon and colour · {code}
look.colourHint: Tells values apart; the words still carry the meaning.

wait.busy: Wait: a change is being saved.
wait.loading: Wait until the fields are read.
wait.noManage: Needs the right to manage fields.
wait.code: Give a key: lower-case letters, digits and underscores, from a letter.
wait.codeTaken: This key is taken on this record type (archived fields keep theirs).
wait.labelLong: A label is at most 80 characters.
wait.section: Give a section: lower-case letters, digits and underscores, from a letter.
wait.unit: A unit is at most 20 characters.
wait.noGrain: You hold no money right: a money field needs one.
wait.grainNotHeld: Only a money right you hold can be picked.
wait.noList: There is no list yet: make one on Picklists first.
wait.linkTo: Pick the record type it links to.
wait.moveSearching: Clear the search to move rows.
wait.allArchived: Every selected field is archived already.
wait.allActive: Every selected field is active already.
wait.portalRecord: Partners never read this record type in the portal.
wait.portalPersonal: Personal data never goes to the portal.
wait.portalMoney: Only a price goes to the portal, never a cost, a margin or pay.
wait.listInUse_one: {count} active field picks from this list: archive it first.
wait.listInUse_other: {count} active fields pick from this list: archive them first.
wait.listCode: Give a key: lower-case letters, digits and underscores, from a letter.
wait.listArchived: The list is archived: restore it first.
wait.listFull: A list holds at most 200 values.
wait.valueCode: Give a code: upper-case letters, digits and underscores.
wait.valueCodeTaken: The list has this code already.
wait.description: A description is at most 500 characters.
wait.allOn: Every selected value is offered already.
wait.allOff: No selected value is offered now.
wait.customer: Pick the customer this field is for.

fault.code: The key was refused: lower-case letters, digits and underscores, from a letter.
fault.valueTakenInactive: The list has this code, not offered: offer it again instead.
fault.typeFull: This record type has 200 active fields: archive one first.
fault.listInUse: Fields still pick from this list: archive them first.
fault.restoreList: This cannot be restored now: read the page again.
fault.listGone: That list is archived or gone: pick another.
fault.listArchived: The list is archived: restore it first.
fault.database: The database refused the change: read the page again.
fault.stale: Someone changed it first: read the page again and repeat.
fault.labelIt: The Italian label was refused: one line of up to 80 characters.
fault.labelEn: The English label was refused: one line of up to 80 characters.
fault.section: The section was refused: lower-case letters, digits and underscores.
fault.unit: The unit was refused: one line of up to 20 characters, on a number only.
fault.audience: Who sees it was refused: a money field is seen only with its money right.
fault.grain: The money right was refused: only one you hold can be used.
fault.portal: The portal shows only a field everyone in the office sees, or a price.
fault.linkTo: Pick a record type to link to.
fault.colour: Pick one of the colours offered.
fault.icon: Pick one of the icons offered.
fault.description: A description is at most 500 characters.
fault.invalid: The change was refused: check what you typed.
fault.forbidden: Your role does not allow this change.
fault.stepUp: This change asks for a fresh sign-in code.
fault.gone: It is gone or archived: read the page again.
fault.signedOut: You are signed out: sign in again.
fault.rateLimited: Too many changes at once: wait a moment and try again.
fault.offline: No connection: the change may not have been saved. Check again when you are back online.
fault.read: The fields could not be read.
fault.readForbidden: Your role does not allow reading fields and lists.
fault.fieldElsewhere: That field is not on this record type: pick its record type.

done.archivedMany_one: {count} field archived: its values are kept.
done.archivedMany_other: {count} fields archived: their values are kept.
done.partly: {done} of {total} done; the others were refused.

cf.hint: Fields added without code in Admin › Fields & lists.
cf.errorTitle: The custom fields could not be read
cf.noEdit: Changing {record} is not in your role.
cf.changedBody: Read them again to see the latest values; what you typed here is dropped.
cf.hiddenRecord: A record you may not open
cf.someOff: Values no longer offered are left out; a record keeps the one it has.

check.places: Too many decimals for this currency.

customer.everyHint: On the records of every customer ({record}).
customer.oneHint: Only on one customer's records ({record}): its sheet, its forms and its portal. No other customer sees it, not even its name.
customer.searchHint: The active customers of the field's company.
customer.cannotSearch: You may not read the customers: ask for the customers' right, or make the field for every customer.
customer.searchFailed: The customers could not be read. Try again.
customer.previewEvery: Shown on the records of every customer ({record}).
